summary.name: gPodder
summary.one_liner: gPodder is an open source podcast client and media aggregator in development since 2005.
use_cases: subscribe to and download podcasts on a desktop
aggregate media feeds in one client
run a podcast client on Linux or BSD
use a portable podcast app on Windows
manage podcast episodes on Sailfish OS
summary.what_it_does: gPodder is a simple open source podcast client that also acts as a media aggregator. The project has been in development since 2005. The page lists the latest version as 3.11.5, released 2024-12-17. Installers and builds are offered for Windows (installer and portable app) and macOS. On Linux and BSD it can be installed via Flatpak, distributions, or run from Git. Other listed options are Sailfish OS, an Ubuntu PPA, and source code.
notable: Open source with a codebase in development since 2005
Available as Flatpak and through Linux distributions
caveats: The page does not describe specific features beyond podcast client and media aggregator
The macOS entry gives no separate installation details
